### Original Description
PraisonAI (pip package praisonaiagents) before 1.6.78 automatically loads defaults from a project-local .praisonai/config.toml when constructing an Agent, and does not validate the defaults.output.output_file path. A repository-controlled config file can set output_file to an absolute or '..' traversal path; when the developer subsequently calls agent.start() without explicitly passing an output parameter, PraisonAI writes the agent response to that path (creating parent directories as needed), allowing an untrusted checked-out project to overwrite files outside the project root with the privileges of the user running PraisonAI.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-rrqj-82cc-g6h4", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-08T16:36:28Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rrqj-82cc-g6h4", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-rrqj-82cc-g6h4"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-07-10T15:16:49Z", "published_at": "2026-07-10T15:31:41Z", "references": ["https://github.com/MervinPraison/PraisonAI/security/advisories/GHSA-qjw5-xwrp-xwpq", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-60089", "https://github.com/MervinPraison/PraisonAI/commit/3aa9cbc2bd49c23a32be0a89a5e620d13d843eab", "https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/praisonai-before-path-traversal-via-config-toml", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rrqj-82cc-g6h4"], "repository_advisory_url": null, "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "", "summary": "Duplicate Advisory: PraisonAI: Project config can auto-save agent output outside the project root", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-08T16:36:29Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-rrqj-82cc-g6h4", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": null, "package": {"ecosystem": "pip", "name": "praisonaiagents"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "<= 1.6.77"}], "withdrawn_at": "2026-10-08T16:36:28Z"}
